name: SC-06
label: Safe D

key_factors: Large fundraising edge ($1.2M raised vs. no reported totals for Peterson)
model.rationale: Clyburn, a longtime incumbent in a D+13 district with a big money advantage and no competitive polling or ratings suggesting trouble, is a clear favorite; markets price his win odds near 97%. The fundamentals-based margin of roughly 22 points stands with no evidence to move it.
model.watch: Any surprise polling showing a single-digit race or major outside spending against Clyburn would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
South Carolina's 6th District is a heavily Democratic, majority-Black district that Jim Clyburn has held for decades. He enters the general election with a large financial advantage, more than $1.6 million on hand, while Republican John Peterson has reported no fundraising totals. No public polls or expert ratings track this race, but prediction markets put Clyburn's win odds near 97 percent.

The district's partisan lean plus Clyburn's incumbency and national profile make an upset highly unlikely. The forecast expects Clyburn to win by roughly 22 points, consistent with the seat's fundamentals.
